name: Guided Tours at Galeria Municipal
description: Join a guided tour of the gallery's three current exhibitions, including works by Leonor Parda and Augustas Serapinas.
longDescription:
On May 2, 2026, the Galeria Municipal do Porto offers guided tours of its current exhibitions. These tours provide an opportunity to explore the gallery's three concurrent presentations, which feature artistic contributions from Leonor Parda and Augustas Serapinas, among others. The initiative aims to provide context and deeper understanding of the contemporary art on display within the municipal institution.

Visitors attending the guided tours can expect an informative walk-through of the gallery's spaces, led by knowledgeable guides. The tours are designed to facilitate engagement with the artworks and the curatorial narratives. The Galeria Municipal do Porto is a prominent venue for contemporary art in the city, providing a dedicated setting for these artistic explorations.

Details regarding pricing are available upon inquiry. The Galeria Municipal do Porto is located within walking distance of the São Bento train station and is accessible via various bus routes. Specific information on accessibility features is recommended to be confirmed directly with the venue.
